_comment: Thresholds and account defaults for ads/audit.py. Every value is a [D] default from ads/playbook.md unless tagged. Edit freely; no code change needed. Parents (ASINs, prices, margins, stage) live in ads/parents.json, which is gitignored; see parents.example.json.

thresholds._benchmark_note: waste/pause benchmarks scale with the product: a target qualifies when its zero-order click count is statistically unlikely at the parent's CVR (waste_confidence / pause_confidence) AND spend exceeds waste_lost_orders x (price x target ACoS). waste_spend_min and pause_min_clicks are only the fallback when the parent has no price or CVR.
